description:
Our Nemesis frame is built to last and take a serious beating. This fully heat-treated chromo frame features super thick 6mm thick CNC machined dropouts and super short 12.7"" chainstay and steeper 75.5 degree headtube angle, giving you a responsive and agile feeling steed.
The Nemesis uses straight gauge tubing for extra dent resistance, and a taller 125mm headtube to eliminate the need for spacers under your stem. Put through all kinds of hell by the Radio Bikes team, the Nemesis is one tough steed built for absolutely anything, street, park even dirt!
INCLUDES LIFETIME GUARANTEE.

super tough frame with modern, technical geometry for street and park riding

extra thick tubing to resist denting

Mid size BB and integrated head tube

125mm tall headtube to reduce the need for stem spacers.

removable brake mounts & cable guides and holes for rotor tabs on head tube

INCLUDES LIFETIME GUARANTEE

CNC machined 6mm thick and heat treated
